run6_vs_run7_summary.interpretation_for_research_prompt: Run7 improved the selected monitor metric while regressing held-out verification recall, suggesting possible calibration or positive-margin damage rather than a plain implementation failure.

gpt_pro_web_attempt.details: tool_search exposed node_repl, OpenAI docs, Figma, and unrelated connector tools, but no Browser/iab control tool for ChatGPT.com Pro in this session.

initial_attempts.details: The first curl request produced a zero-byte raw.json body after a long wait and was terminated before any API body or response id was available.

diagnosis: Run7 does not look like an obvious hard-negative implementation leak: the preflight proved finite OVR-BCE, default-off parity, no true-label negatives, and no test-mined pairs for training.
The likely failure is split-specific verification calibration damage: OVR-BCE improved monitor false-positive behavior but may have suppressed held-out positive probabilities or compressed margins.
The combination of slightly higher top-1, lower top-5, and materially lower held-out verification recall suggests rank/probability distribution damage rather than a simple accuracy-only failure.
research_conclusion.selected_preflight: Run one local paired run6-vs-run7 verification calibration audit with inference/evaluation only: reproduce monitor/test recall, compare per-class thresholds, positive/negative quantiles, positive margins, rank distributions, hard-negative pair deltas, and monitor-vs-test delta correlation.
pass_criteria: Recomputed run6 test recall@FAR10 is within +/-0.0005 of 0.8038559556786704.
Recomputed run7 test recall@FAR10 is within +/-0.0005 of 0.7759.
Monitor best-checkpoint scores reproduce within +/-0.0005 of run6 0.8169 and run7 0.8276.
Counts match train/monitor/test 7011/955/2369, classes 95, feature dim 90.
No test-mined pairs are marked as training supervision and no class-id or label mismatch is detected.
For classes where run7 test recall regressed by at least 0.10, at least 70% show worse positive q25 or median margin.
Monitor-improved classes show lower or equal non-class q90 in at least 60% of classes.
Per-class test recall delta correlates with per-class positive-margin delta at Spearman rho >= 0.50.
fail_conditions: The audit requires training or backward passes.
The audit writes checkpoints, exports, or browser artifacts.
Data counts or class counts mismatch.
The audit detects test-derived training supervision.
The regression is not explained by positive-margin or calibration damage.

future_paid_run_if_audit_passes.launch_condition: Only after the paired calibration audit passes and records positive-margin/calibration damage as the dominant run7 regression mode.
future_paid_run_if_audit_passes.recipe: Repeat the run6/run7 data/model/optimizer envelope with OVR-BCE enabled at lower weight 0.01 instead of 0.03, still using batch-label negatives and monitor_verification_recall_far10 checkpoint selection.

future_paid_run_kill_conditions: Kill immediately if loss is NaN or Inf.
Kill immediately if data counts differ from 7011/955/2369, class count differs from 95, feature dim differs from 90, or expected optimizer steps differ from 13200.
Kill immediately if uses_test_mined_pairs_for_training becomes true or selected_negative_matches_true_label is greater than 0.
Kill immediately if OVR-BCE selected negative count is zero after the first full epoch.
Kill if checkpoint metric is not monitor_verification_recall_far10.
Kill at epoch 48 if best monitor recall@FAR10 is below 0.8219.
Kill at epoch 80 if best monitor recall@FAR10 is below 0.8276.
Kill if monitor verification collapses below 0.75 for five consecutive evaluated epochs after epoch 20.
Kill if weighted OVR-BCE contribution exceeds 1% of base loss for two consecutive epochs.
